board.name: aper_oculus_k26i
board.description: ApotheoTech Aper-Oculus Kria carrier (APT-KRIA-FMC Rev 1.00): FMC (LA00-33, 4 TX / 2 RX GTH), FRAMOS SLVS-EC (2 lanes), 2x 4-lane MIPI CSI-2, mini DisplayPort, USB 3.0, SATA, microSD, IMU + barometer, quad USB-UART/JTAG. SOM: Kria K26I (xck26-sfvc784-2LVI-i).

component.name: part0
component.description: Kria K26I SOM (xck26-sfvc784-2LVI-i) on the Aper-Oculus carrier (APT-KRIA-FMC Rev 1.00)

interface.name: ps8_fixedio
interface.description: Zynq UltraScale+ PS: SOM DDR4/QSPI/eMMC plus carrier UART, I2C, SD, USB 3.0, DP, SATA

interface.name: gth_refclk0
interface.description: GTH reference clock 0 from Si570 U3

interface.name: slvs_ec_ctrl
interface.description: SLVS-EC sensor control and sync signals

interface.name: board_ctrl_3bits
interface.description: DP power enable, fan, barometer protocol select

interface.name: board_status_5bits
interface.description: FMC present, DP power fault and power-monitor alerts

component.name: sys_clk_200mhz
component.description: 200 MHz LVDS oscillator U7 on HPA_CLK0 (bank 66, global clock pins C3/C2).

component.name: gth_refclk0
component.description: Programmable Si570 U3 into MGTREFCLK0_224. Intended for the SLVS-EC lanes; any GTH channel can use it. Starts at 300 MHz; reprogram over PS I2C0, mux 0x76 channel 2.

component.name: cam0
component.description: 22-pin 4-lane MIPI CSI-2 connector J13 on bank 66. Camera I2C is on PS I2C0, mux 0x76 channel 5. Reset/GPIO are in cam_ctrl_4bits.

component.name: cam1
component.description: 22-pin 4-lane MIPI CSI-2 connector J14 on bank 66. Camera I2C is on PS I2C0, mux 0x76 channel 4. Reset/GPIO are in cam_ctrl_4bits.

component.name: cam_ctrl
component.description: Bits: [0] cam0_reset_n, [1] cam0_gpio1, [2] cam1_reset_n, [3] cam1_gpio1. Resets go through PIC U4.

component.name: slvs_ec_iic
component.description: Sensor I2C on bank 64 (VADJ, must be 1.8 V), 2.21k pull-ups to PL_1V8.

component.name: slvs_ec_ctrl
component.description: Bits: [0] rst_n, [1] xce, [2] xmaster, [3] xhs, [4] xvs, [5] trig1, [6] gpio7_trig2, [7] tout0, [8] tout1, [9] tout2, [10] gpio6, [11] gpio10_omode_fsm, [12] gpio14_slamode2, [13] gpio16_slamode1, [14] miso.

component.name: imu
component.description: 6-axis IMU U9 on SPI (bank 44, 3.3 V). Mode 0 or 3, up to 24 MHz.

component.name: imu_int
component.description: Bits: [0] INT1, [1] INT2/FSYNC/CLKIN. Tri-state so INT2 can be driven as FSYNC/CLKIN.

component.name: baro
component.description: Barometric pressure sensor IC22 on SPI (bank 44, 3.3 V). Hold board_ctrl[2] (baro_ps) low for SPI.

component.name: board_ctrl
component.description: Bits: [0] dp_pwr_en, [1] fan_pwm_n (active low), [2] baro_ps. Preset defaults to 0b001: DP power on, fan on, barometer in SPI mode.

component.name: board_status
component.description: Bits (all active low): [0] fmc_prsnt_m2c_n, [1] dp_pwr_fault_n, [2] som_5v_alert_n, [3] vadj_imon_alert_n, [4] vadj_pmbus_alert_n. Preset enables the GPIO interrupt.

component.name: fmc
component.description: FMC J1 (HPC footprint). Wired: LA00-LA33, CLK0/CLK1_M2C, GBTCLK0_M2C, DP0-DP1 (TX+RX), DP2-DP3 (TX only). VADJ is 1.8 V max (HP banks 64/65). LA30/LA32/LA33 are on HD bank 43 and single-ended only; LA32 and LA33 are not on P/N pairs.
